scope: Qualified native prerequisite for independent creator-thread SVG caches. This does not add or qualify complete language SVG/SvgPaint/SvgCache bindings or a new resident child-view protocol.
behavior: Independent document Fonts share the original Face and identical nonempty outline pointers; source bytes are not copied per document.
Parallel document/Font creation/destruction and fallback replacement/clear pass. Init preserves its reset behavior, releases the old fallback and keeps document-owned Faces usable.

Nonempty outline OOM prefixes: 4 failed/20 passed; fallback replacement 3/21 and acquisition 1/15. Failures preserve owned state and retry; warmed full cleanup returns exact LiveCount/LiveBytes and error counters.

costs.notes: Atomic Face reference operations, fallback spin plus temporary Face ref at cold acquisition, and possible duplicate cold bucket/outline allocation under contention are real native costs. No timing, RSS or end-to-end zero-overhead claim.

notes: Final nonempty test fixture and permanent gate are pinned separately from the immutable native freezes unused earlier test copy; the three compiled native source overrides match exactly.

Linux TSan instruments the canonical XRT implementation including allocator/locks/atomics and the aggregate. Remaining archive objects are uninstrumented. GCC reports its atomic_thread_fence instrumentation limitation.

Historical uninstrumented-host TSan diagnostics are preserved, not substituted for full-XRT TSan acceptance. Aggregate debug line tables can name miniaudio.h misleadingly; symbols and exact source/dependency inventories identify the code.
remaining: Complete safe Svg/SvgCache/SvgPaint declarations and actual language rendering/cache/thread/callback acceptance.
